note: Expected answers live here and are never passed to the workflow. Tests load this file separately and compare it to the produced decision (CLR-005).
why: The bullish structure signal at 0.71 would qualify on its own, and a tradeable call spread is available in the chain, so this is a refusal on evidence rather than a refusal on missing data.
A bearish momentum signal at 0.78 clears the 0.70 contradiction veto, so the deterministic classifier declines to produce a setup at all.
Refusing before thesis synthesis is the intended behaviour: the model is never asked to adjudicate contradictory evidence, because it has no authority to resolve it.
This case must remain a refusal even after the Phase 3 model path is added; if the model can turn it into a trade, the firewall has failed.
